title: Dinosaur Outpost at Town Square in Las Vegas
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Step back in time at Dinosaur Outpost Las Vegas, where life-size animatronic dinosaurs, erupting volcanoes, and over 30 interactive exhibits bring the prehistoric world to life. Perfect for families and dino fans of all ages, this immersive attraction lets you meet and feed dinosaurs, explore nests, and even ride Annie the Pachyrhinosaurus. From hands-on activities to unforgettable photo ops, Dinosaur Outpost is the ultimate dinosaur adventure in Las Vegas.
